knots=np.linspace(0.5,10,14)
def hat(x):
    H=np.zeros((len(x),len(knots)))
    for j in range(len(knots)):
        if j>0:
            m_=(x>=knots[j-1])&(x<=knots[j]); H[m_,j]=(x[m_]-knots[j-1])/(knots[j]-knots[j-1])
        if j<len(knots)-1:
            m_=(x>=knots[j])&(x<=knots[j+1]); H[m_,j]=np.maximum(H[m_,j],(knots[j+1]-x[m_])/(knots[j+1]-knots[j]))
    return H

 'hyp':lambda t,q: t/(abs(q[0])+t),
 'tanh':lambda t,q: np.tanh(q[0]*t),
 'texp':lambda t,q: t*np.exp(-q[0]*t),
 'sqrtsat':lambda t,q: np.sqrt(1-np.exp(-q[0]*t)),
}
